name: Sasa Shun'ichi
source:
Hobbies: Guitar.
Special skills: At the beginning he had quite intimidated everyone with his ear training.
Likes: Guitar, the sea in winter, Japanese sweets, his grandmother, the smell of tatami, thick-legged dogs.
Hates: His past, guys that only talk (but don't act).

A first-year student of the Sociology Department at Chihaya University. He is selfish, moody, and sometimes stoic.

[Translated from [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/your_psp/chara_sasa.html]the official site (PSP edition)[/url].]
